E1119

`align({value})` is not a usable layout alignment.

What

`align({value})` is not a usable layout alignment.

Why

`#Layout(c, align(N))` requires a positive power-of-two supported by the selected target profile and the portable baseline; `#Layout(c, align(target, N))` uses the selected target profile without the extra portable baseline; {reason}.

Fix

Write `#Layout(c, align({suggestion}))` with a positive power-of-two supported by the selected profile, or use `align(target, N)` only with a profile fact that proves the larger boundary.
